supersession_reason: v1 requires a private exact-site/range-sector geometry before candidate generation. For SENTINEL units this reverses the intended discovery direction, and CIR12/CIR13 additionally depend on the first P02-validated wild population. No prospective ACSP field outcome was opened before this amendment.

CIR02.broad_occurrence_evidence_role: declared uncertainty footprints may contribute support after outer-frame freeze; they do not define the country outer frame and cannot become exact anchors

CIR06.broad_occurrence_evidence_role: legacy evidence may be retained as context only; it does not define a local kernel or exact site

CIR12.broad_occurrence_evidence_role: declared uncertainty footprints may contribute support after outer-frame freeze; the P02 first-population outcome cannot define the outer frame

CIR13.broad_occurrence_evidence_role: coarse range context may contribute later source-backed support only; the P02 first-population outcome cannot define the outer frame

stage_separation.stage_1_now_frozen: geometry-only complete Japan country outer frame
stage_separation.stage_2_next: attach source-backed ecological primitives without private exact-site geometry
stage_separation.stage_3_after_stage_2_freeze: derive a tractable coarse ecological candidate universe and freeze coverage/structure ordering
stage_separation.stage_4_downstream_only: OSM movement feasibility and field allocation

forbidden: do not use P02 first validated populations to define CIR12/CIR13 candidate membership
do not use private exact-site coordinates to define the v2 outer frame
do not select country-lattice tiles from focal occurrences
do not convert uncertain or legacy records into exact known-point kernels
do not tune the 2-degree lattice or 800-point density on Cirsium field outcomes
do not claim the country outer frame is occupancy, selector superiority or field efficiency
claim_boundary: v2 freezes only an outcome-blind broad candidate universe representation. It does not promote a structural selector, estimate occupancy, identify exact sites, or authorize prospective field-outcome opening.
